title: What is Ethical: AIHED Driving Humans or Human-Driven AIHED? A Conceptual Framework enabling the ‘Ethos’ of AI-driven Higher education

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative meta-synthesis of academic literature and institutional case studies regarding algorithmic grading systems, educational disparities, and the digital divide in higher education.
Qualitative meta-synthesis of secondary data concerning predictive analytics flagging minority students and the disparate impacts of invasive AI proctoring tools.
Qualitative meta-synthesis of literature reviewing AI-driven decision-making systems, such as automated hiring and faculty evaluation tools.
